spec.name: Halloween Drowned Angler Ghost
spec.description: A friendly pale teal spectral fisherman with a broad fishing hat, weathered ragged coat, curled floating tail and a slender fishing rod. Connected, axis-aligned geometry preserves open space around the arms, torn hem and fishing line. Static armor rig; no feet, stand or animations.

prompt: Friendly spectral pale teal ghost fisherman with ragged coat, fishing hat and wispy tail, no feet. Single connected blocky model, static pose, x,z0..16 y0..24. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
